quest.title: Gourmet Supremos, Assemble!
quest.description: You meet an odd bunch of people out in Inazuma's wilds...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Recipe: Sakura Tempura x1, Delicious Sakura Tempura x3, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Uh, Parvaneh, are there really branches like that around here?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I think so. That's what it says here in this book...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Urgh... I'm starving...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hey, Parvaneh, why don't you look up some other method in your dictionary?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: What do you think I am, omnipotent!? Besides, this isn't a dictionary. It's just a travelogue from the Akademiya!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Fine. Just think of a way, please. Otherwise, we'll have to eat grilled fish again.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Gr—Grilled fish... Ugh, let's just go back to the town and get an adventurer to help, or put up a commission, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Isn't that what you used to do back in Liyue when you had a problem?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: That was Liyue... We're in Inazuma now. We're strangers to this land...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you all doing?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Are you... an adventurer? A traveler? Or both...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Well, forget it. Who cares? I guess this is fate.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: We're the Gourmet Supremos. We're currently traveling around the world in a quest to improve our culinary skills.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Ugh, I'm begging you, can you please not say that name out loud...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hahaha, come on, it's fine! Anyway, Traveler, are you also going in to collect Sakura Blooms?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: If so, I'm afraid you'll be disappointed. This place has been blocked by some kind of weird contraption. There's no way in.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Oh, is that so? Alright then. But if it strikes your fancy, it would be nice if you could help us give this barrier a bit of thought.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Parvaneh found a method in her book.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: It says that you need to touch a Thunder Sakura Bough before you can get through this barrier.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: But as for those Thunder Sakura Boughs... To be honest, we have no idea what they really look like.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, that's the run-down of our situation. We're still trying to find a way in.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why do you want to get in?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We'd like to get some of the Sakura Blooms inside ourselves, of course.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I've heard that the Sakura Blooms here have the best mouthfeel, and are perfect for cooking.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, we'll keep trying our luck around here. Let us know if you find some leads, Traveler.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: ...Mr. Xudong. Is that really how you ask someone for a favor?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Eh? *cough* Oh right. Traveler, if you could help us bring some Sakura Blooms out from inside...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: If you could do that, never mind the payment, Xudong here will also make you some really awesome food!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: You're really good at making these deals, huh, Julie...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, that's how it is, Traveler. Please help us, if you don't mind.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Oh? You're really going in?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, that method was recorded inside Parvaneh's dictionary—

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I told you! It's not a dictionary. It's a travelogue from the Akademiya!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, whatever the case, she found a way.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: It says you need to touch a Thunder Sakura Bough before you can get through this barrier.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: But as for those Thunder Sakura Boughs... To be honest, we have no idea what they really look like.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: There aren't any photos in this book either.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I'm officially sick of eating grilled fish. If I can get my hands on some of those Sakura Blooms, I'm sure I can whip something nice up...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I've heard that the ones here have the best mouthfeel, and make for perfect cooking ingredients. But why, oh why does there have to be a barrier here...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, we'll keep trying our luck around here. Let us know if you find some leads, Traveler.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: ...Mr. Xudong. Is that really how you ask someone for a favor?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Eh? *cough* Oh right. Traveler, if you could help us bring some Sakura Blooms out from inside...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: If you could do that, never mind the payment, Xudong here will also make you some really awesome food!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: You're really good at making these deals, huh, Julie...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, that's how it is, Traveler. Please help us, if you don't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Parvaneh, is there really no other way to do this?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: My book only mentions this one way.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Heh, if only it was just a bunch of monsters barring our path...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are these the Sakura Blooms you've been looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Ah! Yes, that they are! And this color...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Woohoo! Guess we can finally eat now!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Wait, you've already passed through that barrier? Did you use the method I told you about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That I did.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Could you tell me where you found that Thunder Sakura Bough?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: When you touched that Bough, how did the Electrogranum come to rest upon you?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: ...Wait, I'm sorry, let me pull out my notebook. So, did you feel anything after the Electrogranum attached itself to you? And...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Parvaneh, please, give this Traveler a moment. They just helped us out... I think your research can wait a bit, right?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Thank you very much, Traveler. As we agreed, you will be paid.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: But before that, just wait here with us for a while. I believe I'll be able to make a dish with the Sakura Blooms you brought.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I've heard of an Inazuman specialty known as Sakura Tempura. I suppose now's the time to try it out.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Give me a while to prepare. It shouldn't take too long, so come find me in a moment.

talks.objective: Give the Special Sakura Bloom to Xudong

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: It goes like this... and this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you finished it yet?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Just hold on a moment... wrap it up in flour, put it in to dry...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: And there we go! Sakura Tempura — try it while it's hot!

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: I—It's delicious! ... If a bit too hot...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Xudong, I believe that this "tempura" also needs to be served with a special dipping sauce...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: A dipping sauce? Well, I must say that I haven't prepared one of those yet. I'll look into it next time should we get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: This serving of Sakura Tempura is yours, Traveler. Please take it as thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Ah yes, I'll give you a copy of the recipe too. Just give me a moment to write it down...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Try it yourself if you get the chance! Cooking is really fun, you know?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Don't mention it!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We'll be in Inazuma for a while, so I suspect that we might head to <color=#00E1FFFF>Kannazuka</color> later.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Julie says that she also wants to see that Sacred Sakura Tree at the Grand Narukami Shrine.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: They say that all the Sakura Blooms on this island fell from that huge tree.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I wonder, how large must that tree have been to have so many leaves fall from it...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: You should pay it a visit if it takes your fancy, too.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Thank you for your help once again, Traveler. Well, I'm going to have a bite too. I'm starving...

choices.text: Where will you all be going next?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Parvaneh, is there really no other way to do this?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: My book only mentions this one way.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Heh, if only it was just a bunch of monsters barring our path...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you repeat that method of yours to me again?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Eh, allow me. Basically, you need to search for something nearby known as a Thunder Sakura Bough and touch it.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: After that, something known as an Electrogranum will attach itself to you, and that will allow you to pass through the barrier.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Amazing, so the travelogue was correct about all this after all.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Looks like we'll get to have some good grub after all! Thanks, Traveler!
